description: Sample and score designs for a fixed backbone with the official ESM-IF1 inverse-folding model.

atom_dim.title: 原子维度
atom_dim.description: Dim name of the structure form's atom axis.

field_dim.title: 字段维度
field_dim.description: Dim name of the structure form's field axis.

sample_dim.title: 样本维度
sample_dim.description: Dim name assigned to the sampled designs on the output form.

chain.title: 设计链
chain.description: Chain that is redesigned from its N/CA/C backbone.

model_path.title: ESM-IF 权重路径
model_path.description: Local ESM-IF1 checkpoint such as esm_if1_gvp4_t16_142M_UR50.pt. No weights are downloaded automatically.

num_samples.title: 采样数量
num_samples.description: Number of sequences sampled with the autoregressive decoder.

temperature.title: 采样温度
temperature.description: Softmax temperature of the decoder; lower values stay closer to the backbone's native sequence.

seed.title: 随机种子
seed.description: Torch seed set before sampling so repeated runs give the same designs.

output.title: 输出名称
output.description: Form name registered in the execution context.
